payload.rebuttal: fixed: The witness filed its gating lint failures as a.py then b.py, which happens to match alphabetical file order too, so the mutant (ORDER BY file instead of ORDER BY failure_id) produced the same table and the test couldn't tell them apart. I changed the fixture to record b.py before a.py, so the recorded order and the file-sorted order differ, and updated the expected rows to match the recorded order. I confirmed by hand-applying the exact mutant: the test now fails against it and passes against the real code.
